description: This file defines a command handler class for adjusting savings transactions in the Fineract platform. It handles commands of type 'ADJUSTTRANSACTION' for savings accounts, interacts with the SavingsAccountWritePlatformService to perform the adjustment, and is marked as a Spring service with transaction management.

classes.name: SavingsTransactionAdjustmentCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class implementing command handler for adjusting savings transactions based on commands of type 'ADJUSTTRANSACTION'. It delegates the transaction adjustment to the write platform service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the adjustment command, extracts the transaction ID, and calls the write platform service to perform the adjustment.
